The viscous friction force depends on velocity, viscosity, and area.
area, shape, and fluid density determine the damping coefficient.
coefficient values are taken into account in the physical pendulum model when fluid drag is significant.
significant fluid drag requires using a damped physical pendulum model for accurate predictions.
